statement.zh: 古典文献（如《厄立特里亚海航行记》传统）与考古将阿杜利斯定为红海贸易港（Burstein；Manzo）。
statement.en: Classical texts (Periplus tradition) and archaeology identify Adulis as a Red Sea trade port (Burstein; Manzo).
